# Code style (rebuild policy)

Comments
- Comment only the *why* the code cannot show: a constraint, a non-obvious reason, a workaround with its cause.
- Never narrate or restate code ("Step 1", "Now we...", "Loop over the items").
- Never reference the task, ticket, conversation or change history ("added for X", "fixed bug"). That belongs in git.
- Doc comments only on exported API, one line by default.
- Match the comment density of the surrounding file.

Scope
- Write the smallest change that meets the acceptance criteria; edit existing code before adding new code.
- No abstraction with a single implementation, no option or config the spec did not ask for, no handling of a case that cannot happen.
- No new file, layer, dependency or public export the spec does not name. If you think one is needed, say so instead of adding it.
- Follow the patterns already in the codebase; do not restructure code outside the task.
